Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — Finovia is kicking off a scheduled external audit window for ISO 27001 later this year and our regulator team is also scoped to do a FedRAMP readiness check in November. Our auditors asked for a few clarifications about evidence windows and a small set of exceptions in the SIG/CAIQ we flagged during scoping.

Quick asks up front:
- Can Redwood commit to a continuous evidence export window (logs + retention info) for a 30-day sampling period in Oct 15 — Nov 15?
- Is there a standard place you publish SOC 2 reports and recent ISO statements, or should we expect a timeboxed secure upload for the auditor?
- We have one SIG control where we need explicit exception language on third-party backups (marked in the attached intake). Can you confirm who owns that control?

I've attached our intake form (Finovia_audit_intake_2026.pdf) with auditor contact details. If possible we'd like a short scoping call next week with your evidence owners and our auditor (Auditeasy). Proposed times: Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks — Lina

--

Hi Lina — thanks for the intake and the heads-up. Looping Marissa (Compliance) and Tessa (Security) as owners for the evidence asks; we can cover the SIG exception and the log/export window in the scoping call.

A few immediate answers:
- Evidence window: we can provide a 30-day evidence bundle for Oct 15—Nov 15. That will include retained audit logs, config snapshots for the serving fleet, and retention/ingestion metadata. We will mark specific token/trace data redaction needs on the bundle if you provide those details.
- Reports: we publish the latest SOC 2 Type II report and ISO summary to a secure customer portal; for formal auditor access we can provision a temporary read-only link and a secure archive (PDF + CSV manifests).
- SIG/CAIQ exception: we saw the flagged item on third-party backups. Tessa — can you confirm the backup exception language and whether we can provide a formal compensating control statement?

Next steps I propose now:
1) Schedule a 30-min scoping call next Tue morning PT (I can do 9:00–11:00).
2) Marissa will share an evidence matrix draft and an owner list within 48 hours.
3) Tessa will draft the backup exception text and identify any logs that need redaction.

Attachments I will drop here: redwood_audit-playbook-v1.2.pdf (high-level playbook + retention notes).

Jonas
Staff Product Security, Redwood Inference
